claims.text: The IPA system augments resources with structured and labeled training data by interacting with users.
User inputs are analyzed and labeled automatically by a rule-based system, which assigns the corresponding next action and dialogue-id.
The system updates the information in the ID based on user-provided data, ensuring that the data is structured and accurate.
